args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (error rate 18%, unhealthy in all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions. Rollback completed successfully; monitoring health of v2.3.0.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release, while v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were both healthy.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production — across all regions. The rollback completed successfully.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: Created incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0") documenting the failure and the rollback action. The on-call engineer was paged.

4. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0, healthy in all regions with a 0.2% error rate.

Note: v2.3.1 remains the latest release and should be investigated before any re-deploy attempt.
